method: PGM P5 and simple YAML reparsed from raw bytes with the standard library; occupancy follows the conservative ROS convention free only when probability < free_thresh
canonical G4 grid summary and SHA-256 recomputed without the project module
collision error envelope recomputed with the same binary64 outward-rounding operation order as the audit record
per-lambda declared bounds checked against the independent lower bounds recorded by the adapter; no segment self-report is trusted alone
dynamic max-utilization, whole-domain certificate and all three pointwise interval ratios checked below one

nonclaims: six frozen known-feasible A-only scenes; no general success rate, completeness or optimality is claimed
no real-time, hard-deadline or production acceptance claim
no ROS, Gazebo, hardware or mixed-mode FR06 validation
numerical checks and this report are not Codex acceptance
sampled maxima are not a whole-domain proof; continuous claims rest on the recorded interval operators, bounds and error envelope

numbered_negative_coverage.requirement: thin obstacle between two coarse samples must reject the true swept volume
corner collision with a body heading different from the formation heading must use the real OBB front
the same model with a changed map, limits, goal or stale context/old audit digest must fail binding or be re-audited
an adapter defect that omits the Delta factor must be caught by independent bounds, never trusted from a segment self-report
a construction blocked for the whole-formation circumcircle but passable by the true OBBs must not be rejected for the large circle alone
a deliberately tiny sweep sample budget must fail the audit and remain non-executable
map boundary, unknown occupancy, start/goal collision, NO_MOTION collision, fake solver success, no accepted candidate and budget exhaustion are all non-executable failures

pre_final_corrections.action: note text corrected to the implemented fixed-point envelope before the official run; the arithmetic was independently reproduced
pre_final_corrections.item: collision.py radius_upper_note text said baseline plus 1e-6 m while the implementation used the outward-rounded fixed-point margin

pre_final_corrections.action: route generation is skipped for exact start==goal and the hold collision audit always runs; regression test added
pre_final_corrections.item: an exact NO_MOTION request with a blocked start cell returned NO_ROUTE_GUIDE before the mandatory hold static map/vehicle check

protection.note: G1/G2/G3 source and tests outside the G4 whitelist, old FR06 source, old maps and the old collision engine are unchanged. Path authorization is not Codex acceptance.

scene_freeze.note: Maps and requests are frozen; modifications require a new scene version.  Reference files are not copied into inputs/.
